name: Positivecarry Product Buttons for WooCommerce
author: positivecarry

sections.description:
Positivecarry Product Buttons for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that automatically replaces standard WooCommerce variation dropdown selects with clickable button swatches.

No complex settings or bloated admin panels. Simply activate the plugin, and your product variations will instantly look professional and conversion-ready.

Features:

  • Zero Configuration: Works right out of the box. Just plug and play.
  • Lightweight: No heavy CSS/JS frameworks. It uses vanilla styling and the basic jQuery that WooCommerce already loads.
  • Better UX/UI: Improves customer experience by showing all available options as clear buttons.
  • Selected State: Visual checkmark indicator for selected variations.

🔥 Live Demo / Showcase:
You can see how it is implemented and looks live on the website: https://positivecarry.ru
(Посмотреть как это реализовано и выглядит можно на сайте https://positivecarry.ru)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Done! Visit any variable product page on your site to see the new variation swatches automatically applied.
sections.faq:
Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin consists of a single lightweight function utilizing WordPress native wp_enqueue_scripts. No database queries, no bloated settings, and no external assets.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, it is designed to be universally compatible with any standard WooCommerce theme.
